notes.title: More Pool Rooms! Upcoming Update News!
notes.content:
Upcoming Update News!

Hey everyone! First of all, I want to say a huge thank you to all of you who are playing my game and sharing your thoughts. Your support and interest mean a lot to me!

Recently, I released a Pool Rooms level where you can swim underwater, explore mysterious spaces, and immerse yourself in the atmosphere. Judging by your feedback, many of you enjoyed this concept, and that has inspired me to keep developing the game further!

I’m currently working on a major update that will introduce new Pool Rooms levels with even more intricate architecture, hidden details, and a deeply immersive atmosphere. I also plan to add various artifacts and notes that will reveal more about the lore and secrets of this enigmatic place.

Additionally, I’m considering introducing horror elements. For example, there might be creatures lurking underwater or unsettling moments that could make exploration more intense. But before I proceed, I want to hear from you!

Would you like to see horror elements and mysterious entities in the game? Or do you prefer a relaxing experience without any dangers? Let me know in the comments! If you have any ideas for new mechanics, levels, or story elements, feel free to share—I’ll be reading all your suggestions.

When will the update be released? I can’t give an exact date yet, but I’m actively working on it and want to make it truly special. Stay tuned for more news!

Once again, thank you for your support! I look forward to hearing your thoughts and ideas!

notes.title: Big Update: Story, New Levels, and Underwater Exploration!
notes.content:
Hi!

I've released a major update that brings even more mystery and exploration opportunities to the game. Here's what's new:

🔹 Story – the game now features a storyline.
🔹 New logs – added new logs and improved old ones for easier reading.
🔹 Updated menu – you can now open the level catalog and instantly load any level.
🔹 Five new Pool Rooms levels – dive into mysterious flooded spaces.
🔹 New gameplay mechanics – in Pool Rooms, you can now not only walk through the water but also dive, swim, and explore underwater structures!

Additionally, I've made many small improvements in this update. Some are already available, while others will be coming in the next update.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Big Update: Story, Characters, New Levels, Improved Menu, and More!
notes.content:
Hi!  

I’m preparing a major update that will bring even more atmosphere, mysteries, and possibilities to the game. Here’s what’s coming next:  

🔹 [b]Story and New Characters[/b]
The game will now feature a full-fledged storyline! The narrative will become deeper and more mysterious. New characters will also appear.  

🔹 [b]Improved Notes and Audio Logs[/b]
Explorer notes will be more informative yet shorter, making them easier to read. I’ve revised some, added new ones, and optimized audio logs for a better listening experience.  

🔹 [b]New and Enhanced Video Logs[/b]
I’ve reworked the game’s video materials now they are clearer, more detailed, atmospheric, and better at conveying the essence of what’s happening.  

🔹 [b]Save System for Puzzle Levels[/b]
You’ll now be able to save progress on certain levels with puzzles, making gameplay more convenient.  

🔹 [b]New Level Selection Menu[/b]
This is one of the key changes. When you click “Play,” a [b]level catalog[/b] will open, allowing you to select any level you want to play. No need to start over jump straight into the action!  

🔹 [b]New Levels – Pool Rooms![/b]
I’m adding [b]five new levels[/b] featuring eerie, abandoned pools in this update.  

🔹 [b]Secret Mechanic[/b]
A [b]new gameplay feature[/b] will be introduced, further enhancing immersion into the world of Backrooms.  

🔹 [b]Development of Level 94[/b]
I’m also working on [b]Level 94[/b] one of the most mysterious and visually stunning levels. It will feature a surreal suburban atmosphere and unexpected story twists!  

The update is coming soon, and I’ll announce its release here in the news. Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback your support helps make the game even better!  

Wishing you a great day, and see you soon! 😊

notes.title: Game Update: Welcome to the Pool Rooms!
notes.content:
Hi!  

Thank you for playing my game and exploring the endless halls of the Backrooms. I’m excited to announce that a new update is out, and it brings something special!  

[b]What's New:[/b]
-[b]Added the Pool Rooms level [/b]– you can now immerse yourself in the eerie, flooded hallways and their unsettling atmosphere.  
- Improved entity models in the Backrooms – they are now more detailed and realistic.  
- Enhanced animations – movements are now smoother and more natural.  
- Added new entities – more dangers await.  
- Added improved sounds – for deeper immersion.  
- Added new and upgraded textures – the game looks even better.  
- Updated the menu – now more user-friendly and visually appealing.  

[b]What's Next?[/b]
In the next update, I will continue expanding the Pool Rooms with new levels, as well as adding [b]Level 94[/b] and other locations from the Backrooms universe.  

Thank you for playing! Enjoy the game, have a great day, and stay tuned for more updates!

- Added new entities – more dangers await.

notes.title: BugFix1.3
notes.content:
Thank you for playing our game!

In this update, we have:

Fixed issues with video playback on certain computers. Everything should now work smoothly!
Improved the hint system to make it easier for you to navigate and solve puzzles in the game.

Thank you for your support and feedback! It helps us make the game better. If you encounter any new bugs or want to share your thoughts, feel free to reach out to us!

Good luck in BackRoms: New Gate!
